paraphrase: The nature of mind is unborn — what need of knowing and seeing? Originally there is not one dharma — who speaks of cultivation and refinement? … To use the mind to guard stillness is still not free of sickness; forgetting birth and death is the original nature.

original.text: 心性不生何須知見。本無一法誰論熏鍊
